kind: Pure temporal/data/model checks; no neural optimizer in JavaScript
checks: Left/Right use five features and Both uses ten
Reject missing, non-finite and non-normalized glove values
Hold confirms once and held gestures never retrigger
Short label jitter is ignored; stable Other releases a held gesture
Cooldown delays a new gesture and re-entry is possible after exit
Observation gaps do not count toward stable Hold and reset emits exit
Distance rejection uses RMS normalized features and the predicted class
Native classifier format validates encoder labels, dimensions and weights
Snapshots require gesture-specific identity and rejection examples
Capture limits and independent bank defaults
All 36 ordered pairs have unique labels, titles and independent mapping slots
